rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Initially, we enrolled 171 pediatric patients diagnosed with brainstem tumors and 849 typically developing children from 4 different sites."

rci2_using_epd.detail: fcon_1000.projects dataset (FCON) included in the healthy children reference data.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "To establish a normative model, data from 849 healthy children (age range: 4 -18 years) were collected from publicly available databases, including 72 locally recruited children in Beijing (61 of whom underwent scanning), 69 from the fcon_1000.projects dataset (https://doi.org/10. 15387/fcp_indi.corr.ipcas7) 19 , 450 from the Child Connectome Project (CCNP) 20 , and 269 from the Children ' s Hospital in Guangzhou."
